title: Music
translation: Nothing has the grace and charm of the sacred music and dance for the gods. Of the instruments in general, I like the flute and the reed pipe. The ones I could listen to every day are the lute and the zither.
original: {神楽|かぐら}こそなまめかしく{面白|おもしろ}けれ。
{大|おほ}かた{物|もの}の{音|ね}には{笛|ふえ}{篳篥|ひちりき}、{常|つね}に{聞|き}きたきは{琵琶|びは}{和琴|わごん}。
literal: Among the sounds of instruments in general, the flute and the hichiriki; what one would always like to hear is the biwa and the wagon.

notes.text: {神楽|かぐら}: the music and dance performed for the gods at shrines and at court. こそ … けれ again.
{篳篥|ひちりき}: a short double-reed pipe with a loud, piercing sound, the lead instrument of court music.
{琵琶|びは}: a lute with four strings. {和琴|わごん}: a six-string zither, the native Japanese instrument used in kagura. A short list of personal taste, almost like a profile.
